# Kenney Particle Pack

Official source: https://kenney.nl/assets/particle-pack

Download: https://kenney.nl/media/pages/assets/particle-pack/f8fe0f8cb8-1677578741/kenney_particle-pack.zip

Original archive license: CC0 1.0; see License.txt. Archive identifies version 1.1.

Included smoke_01.png is the unmodified transparent smoke texture used by BoxLab ice mist. Unused alternate textures are kept outside the Unity project. The particle movement, colour, opacity and lifetime are authored by this project. Removing Assets/BoxLabArt restores a generated soft texture fallback.
